summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 of the cipher-box project — a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code covering 7 scope items with no behavior changes.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully (6 plans across 5 waves, all verification gates passed, committed). Execution reached Wave 4 (4/6 plans done): Wave 1 (45-01 test safety net, 45-02 journal-dir helper), Wave 2 (45-03 Option<String> sentinel + serde-compat), and Wave 3 (45-04 typed IpnsResolveOutcome) all completed; Wave 4 (45-05) was spawning at transcript end.

repo: The crate is `cipherbox-fuse` (default feature `fuse`); downstream consumer is `apps/desktop/src-tauri` which imports `JournalOp` fields from `cipherbox-sdk`.
Pre-existing dead-code warnings in vendored `fuser` ABI file (`fuse_abi.rs`) are noise unrelated to project changes — expected and safe to ignore.
Windows `mod.rs` is `cfg`-excluded on macOS, causing rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' warnings that are not real errors.
The scope item for journal-dir deduplication (#12) had a third duplicate in `fuse/windows/mod.rs` that was not originally identified — the executor found and fixed it.
Waves 2–5 all serialize through `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs`, making true parallel execution impractical despite worktrees being enabled.
The GSD plan-system's API surface extractor does not cover Rust (returns 0 symbols); this is a known gap.

code.finding: Type of `file_meta_ipns_name` changed from `String` to `Option<String>` in 45-03; IDE showed E0308 here post-commit but it was stale rust-analyzer cache — `cargo check --workspace` confirmed clean.
Contained a third copy of the journal-dir initialization logic (scope item #12 originally identified only two); fixed as part of 45-02.

workflow: The GSD commit helper can return a false-negative `commit_failed` status even when the commit lands — always verify with `git log` before acting on a reported failure.
Executor subagents may only verify the crate they modified, not downstream consumers; after a type-signature change, manually run `cargo check --workspace` to catch breakage in consuming crates.
Rust-analyzer IDE diagnostics can reflect mid-edit in-progress state from a subagent run and appear as errors after the agent commits; ground-truth is `cargo check --workspace` exit code.
When only one wave has genuine file-level parallelism, sequential execution on the feature branch is safer and simpler than worktree orchestration even when worktrees are technically enabled.
The GSD planning workflow spawns four sequential subagents: researcher → pattern-mapper → planner → plan-checker; each commits its artifact before the next runs.

friction: Commit helper returned false-negative `commit_failed` for the VALIDATION.md commit (340e93efe) — required an extra `git log` verification step.
Post-45-03 IDE diagnostics showed stale rust-analyzer errors (`read_ops.rs:821`, `macros.rs`) that looked like real compile failures, requiring manual `cargo check --workspace` to rule out.
Executor for 45-03 initially only checked `cipherbox-fuse` and `cipherbox-sdk`, not the desktop consumer app — the orchestrator had to catch this gap and run the workspace-wide check itself.
API surface regeneration for Rust returns 0 symbols because the extractor regex doesn't cover Rust — silently produces no intel for the planner.
open_items: Wave 4 Plan 45-05: reuse `publish_file_metadata` in replay + memoize `resolve_folder_key` — was spawning at transcript end, not yet confirmed complete.
Wave 5 Plan 45-06: consolidate fuser/winfsp journal builders into `journal_helpers.rs` (#11) — not yet started.
Pre-existing dead-code warnings in `fuse_abi.rs` (vendored fuser ABI) were noted as pre-existing and explicitly left unfixed — should be tracked as separate cleanup outside Phase 45 scope.
The GSD API surface extractor has no Rust support — zero symbols passed to the planner for Rust phases; this is a gap in the tooling worth addressing separately.
